plain: Joe Rogan, a podcast host, told fellow host Jesse Michels about a vivid dream he had at home in 2025, a few weeks before they spoke. He says very slender, tall, humanlike beings were talking to him, and they were not grey but pinkish, like us. He mentions discussing it with Brett Weinstein and returns to the dream more than once in the conversation. He says the feeling he came away with was that someone was trying to get him used to this kind of contact, which would mean beings preparing people for meeting them if taken at face value.
